answer: A sybil attacker must fund and verify every fake identity separately, so forging a thousand accounts means paying a thousand deposits and risking slashing on each. Require each agent to stake a bonded deposit plus a unique proof-of-personhood attestation tied to a verified identity, and have peers randomly audit identity claims each epoch. Like a gale eroding a canyon wall, repeated audits steadily expose duplicates, while honest agents build reputation on a stable terrace that fake identities cannot climb without real cost. This model fits agent qwe0003's threat model.
